name: AFLALO
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $415 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's leather coats, wool pants, silk tops and rigid jeans (about $450), plus fine jewelry, sold through its website and Soho studio.

quote.q: Silhouettes designed to become your everyday staples, alongside those exquisite few destined for only a handful of unforgettable outings.

opview: “Silhouettes designed to become your everyday staples, alongside those exquisite few destined for only a handful of unforgettable outings.” — AFLALO (house), About, aflalonyc.com

facts_read.source: brand site; Puck 2024-09-19; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

Blouse.hp: Ziva Top in Silk (long-sleeve, heavyweight silk)

Sweater.lp: Artusi Sweater in Wool (superfine merino turtleneck)

doors.note: US: 1 own door, 'The Studio', 56 Greene St, 3rd Floor, New York 10012 — 'open for walk-ins and appointments', Wednesday–Saturday. A third-floor studio rather than a street-level shop; counted because it is open to walk-in customers. No other store on the site. Founded by Yael Aflalo.

craft_evidence.owned: no (a Soho showroom/studio at 56 Greene St, New York; no workshop shown)
craft_evidence.mills: no ('Italian' and 'Japanese' cloth named by origin only)
craft_evidence.madein: 89% (71 of 80: Italy 32, New York 18, Los Angeles 10, Mongolia incl. Inner Mongolia 6, China 5)
craft_evidence.heritage: none — 'founded by Yael Aflalo and her illustrious team'; no year or place given
craft_evidence.reasoning: Nearly every product page names where it is made (Italy, New York, Los Angeles for denim, Mongolia for cashmere), and fabric lines name the cloth's origin. No workshop, maker or mill is named and the about page is two sentences, so it's a 2.
